description: Fund-holding escrow contract for approved payment assets. Admins create and release escrows, with per-action cooldowns, a circuit breaker, signer rotation, and two-step admin transfer.

errors.description: Stable EscrowError codes returned by contract entrypoints. Callers should match on the numeric code rather than parsing messages.

codes.name: AlreadyInitialized
codes.description: init was called more than once.

codes.name: Unauthorized
codes.description: Caller is not authorized for this operation.

codes.name: CooldownActive
codes.description: The action is still inside its cool-off window.

codes.name: InvalidCooldown
codes.description: Cooldown is outside the accepted range of 1 second to 30 days.

codes.name: NoPendingAdmin
codes.description: No admin transfer is currently pending.

codes.name: AssetNotApproved
codes.description: Payment asset is not approved for escrow creation.

codes.name: InvalidInput
codes.description: An input is malformed or forbidden, including a self-address or non-positive amount.

codes.name: EscrowExists
codes.description: An escrow already exists for the payment asset and recipient pair.

codes.name: Paused
codes.description: The contract is paused and the operation is blocked.

codes.name: NotFound
codes.description: No escrow record exists for the payment asset and recipient pair.

types.EscrowRecord: Recorded escrow keyed by payment_asset and recipient.
types.EscrowReleasedEvent: Payload emitted when an escrow is released.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initialize the contract once with an admin, signer, and optional cooldown. If cooldown_secs is omitted, the one-hour default is used.

params.name: admin
params.description: Initial admin address; must authorize the call.

params.name: signer
params.description: Initial escrow signer address.

params.name: cooldown_secs
params.description: Cooldown in seconds, from 1 second through 30 days; None selects the one-hour default.

panics: EscrowError::AlreadyInitialized (code 2) — init was already called.
EscrowError::InvalidCooldown (code 5) — explicit cooldown_secs is outside the accepted range.

functions.name: get_cooldown
functions.description: Return the configured global cool-off window in seconds.
panics: EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — called before init.

functions.name: set_cooldown
functions.description: Update the global cool-off window. The accepted range is 1 second through 30 days.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: secs
params.description: New cooldown in seconds, from 1 through 2,592,000.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::InvalidCooldown (code 5) — secs is outside the accepted range.

functions.name: cooldown_remaining
functions.description: Return seconds remaining before the named action can run again, or zero when it is ready. Does not require initialization.

params.name: action
params.description: Cool-off action tag, such as release, unpause, or rotate.

functions.name: is_ready
functions.description: Return whether the named action may run now.

params.name: action
params.description: Cool-off action tag.

functions.name: get_admin
functions.description: Return the current admin address.
panics: EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — called before init.

functions.name: get_pending_admin
functions.description: Return the nominated admin address, or null when no two-step admin transfer is pending.

functions.name: get_signer
functions.description: Return the current escrow signer address.
panics: EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — called before init.

functions.name: is_paused
functions.description: Return whether the contract is paused. Defaults to false before the first pause call.

functions.name: release
functions.description: Release an escrow to its designated recipient. The record is removed before the token transfer to prevent replay; this critical action is cooldown-guarded.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: payment_asset
params.description: Payment asset contract of the escrow.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Designated recipient of the funds.

panics: EscrowError::Paused (code 11) — contract is paused.
EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::CooldownActive (code 4) — release is inside its cool-off window.
EscrowError::NotFound (code 12) — no record exists for the payment_asset and recipient pair.

functions.name: pause
functions.description: Activate the circuit breaker immediately. This admin action is not cooldown-guarded.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.

functions.name: unpause
functions.description: Deactivate the circuit breaker. This critical action is cooldown-guarded.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::CooldownActive (code 4) — unpause is inside its cool-off window.

functions.name: rotate_signer
functions.description: Replace the current escrow signer. This critical action is cooldown-guarded using the rotate tag.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: new_signer
params.description: Replacement escrow signer; must differ from the current signer.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::CooldownActive (code 4) — rotate is inside its cool-off window.
EscrowError::InvalidInput (code 9) — new_signer equals the current signer.

functions.name: is_asset_approved
functions.description: Return whether an asset is approved for future escrow creation. Approval is deny-by-default.

params.name: asset
params.description: Payment asset contract address.

functions.name: get_escrow
functions.description: Return the escrow record for a payment_asset and recipient pair, or null if no record exists.

params.name: payment_asset
params.description: Payment asset contract address.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Designated recipient address.

functions.name: add_approved_asset
functions.description: Approve a payment asset for future escrow creation. Approving an already-approved asset is idempotent.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: asset
params.description: Payment asset contract to approve; cannot be this contract.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::InvalidInput (code 9) — asset resolves to the escrow contract address.

functions.name: remove_approved_asset
functions.description: Revoke a payment asset's approval for new escrows. Existing escrow records are unchanged; removing an unapproved asset is a no-op.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: asset
params.description: Payment asset contract to revoke; cannot be this contract.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::InvalidInput (code 9) — asset resolves to the escrow contract address.

functions.name: create_escrow
functions.description: Transfer funds from the admin caller into the contract and record a new escrow for an approved payment asset and recipient. The pair cannot be reused, and the contract must not be paused.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin and funder; must authorize.

params.name: payment_asset
params.description: Approved payment asset contract; cannot be this contract.

params.name: recipient
params.description: Designated recipient; cannot be this contract.

params.name: amount
params.description: Escrow amount in asset micro-units; must be positive.

panics: EscrowError::Paused (code 11) — contract is paused.
EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::InvalidInput (code 9) — asset or recipient is the contract itself, or amount is not positive.
EscrowError::AssetNotApproved (code 8) — payment_asset is not approved.
EscrowError::EscrowExists (code 10) — record already exists for the payment_asset and recipient pair.

functions.name: set_admin
functions.description: Nominate a new admin. The current admin retains authority until the nominee accepts the transfer.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: new_admin
params.description: Address of the nominated admin.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.

functions.name: accept_admin
functions.description: Complete the two-step admin transfer. Must be called and authorized by the nominated admin.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must equal the pending admin; must authorize.

panics: EscrowError::NoPendingAdmin (code 6) — no admin transfer is pending.
EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the pending admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.

functions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
functions.description: Cancel a pending admin nomination. Only the current admin may call.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: EscrowError::Unauthorized (code 3) — caller is not the current admin.
EscrowError::NotInitialized (code 1) — contract is not initialized.
EscrowError::NoPendingAdmin (code 6) — no admin transfer is pending.

event_topics.data: Not emitted by the current contract entrypoints; provided by event_version_v1 in events.rs.

EscrowRecord.description: Persistent record for funds escrowed under a payment asset and recipient pair.

payment_asset.description: Payment asset contract bound to the escrow.

recipient.description: Designated recipient of the escrowed funds.

amount.description: Escrow amount in payment asset micro-units.

created_at.description: Ledger timestamp in seconds when the escrow was created.

EscrowReleasedEvent.description: Payload emitted after an escrow is released.

amount.description: Released amount in payment asset micro-units.
